Hi Camila,

Quick note from our side: after rolling a small SSO change this morning our staging connector to Redwood has started failing 500s during token refresh. The integration team is blocked reproducing the issue locally because our staging environment is rate-limited and low traffic — we need a wider sandbox window and some extra credits to run heavier tests.

We have a demo with our executive sponsor on Tuesday (Nov 30) and the sales timeline is tight. If we can get two weeks of extra sandbox capacity and ~200k tokens to run bulk import and retry scenarios, we can validate the fix and keep the demo.

Attached is a short error snippet and the stack traces we can share: connector-debug-log-request.txt (see last 50 lines).

Thanks — can you advise?

— Samir

Thanks for the context.

I dug into the excerpts Samir sent. Hypothesis: our token refresh path is timing out under intermittent burst load because their client is retrying without respecting backoff headers — that will surface as a 500 in our proxy. I can reproduce this if I have:
- a replay of the failing traffic window (ideally pcap or the request timestamps + header dumps)
- a sample payload (size and schema) so I can simulate bulk imports

If Streamline can push over the sample payload and approximate timestamps, I can run a high-concurrency replay in an isolated sandbox instance. That'll take ~3–4 hours compute time but will confirm the root cause.

Operational ask: grant our infra team temporary elevated sandbox limits (the 250k credit Ben proposed is fine) and VIP repro access so I can spin up the replay. Also, please include a note in the ticket that we might need a temporary increase to token-rate limits to reproduce at scale.

I'll keep the repro session contained and will post results + suggested remediation steps in this thread.

— Dev
